BDI.note: Panel speakers warn of AI fakes and call for rules, but state no rule, draft or authority on AI harms.
No government body's use of AI is stated.
Officials call for an AI legal framework; no draft or rule is stated.
No AI tool in a public sector system is stated.
Only a university teaching department on AI; no model, dataset or AI computing is stated.
No training for civil servants is stated.
Only a call to strengthen the fight against cybercrime; no law is stated.
Only a University of Burundi department for teaching AI use, which is a degree course, and a call for digital skills; no public programme is stated.
No cut, punishment or criticism of a named government policy is stated.
